```python
# tests/integration/test_order_flow.py

class TestHappyPath:
    """When everything goes according to plan. 99.1% pure."""
    
    def test_complete_order_flow(self, services, isolated_order):
        # Arrange - The setup is everything
        seed_inventory("BLUE-99", quantity=100)
        
        # Act - Say my name
        response = submit_order(isolated_order)
        
        # Assert - We verify EVERYTHING
        assert response.status == "CONFIRMED"
        assert get_inventory("BLUE-99") == 99  # Reserved
        assert payment_captured(isolated_order["order_id"])
        assert notification_sent(isolated_order["order_id"], type="CONFIRMATION")


class TestServiceFailures:
    """The business is dangerous. Services die."""
    
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("failing_service,expected_state", [
        ("inventory", "REJECTED"),
        ("payment", "PAYMENT_FAILED"),
        ("notification", "CONFIRMED"),  # Non-critical, order proceeds
    ])
    def test_service_failure_compensation(self, services, isolated_order, 
                                          failing_service, expected_state):
        with chaos_monkey(failing_service, error_rate=1.0):
            response = submit_order(isolated_order)
        
        assert response.status == expected_state
        # Compensating transactions executed
        assert inventory_unreserved(isolated_order) if failing_service == "payment" else True


class TestTimeoutBehavior:
    """Patience. Then ruthless action."""
    
    def test_payment_timeout_triggers_retry_then_refund(self, services, isolated_order):
        with latency_injection("payment", delay_ms=5000):
            response = submit_order(isolated_order, timeout=2000)
        
        assert response.status == "PAYMENT_TIMEOUT"
        assert retry_count("payment", isolated_order["order_id"]) == 3
        assert inventory_released(isolated_order)


class TestAsyncMessages:
    """The product moves through channels. We track every gram."""
    
    def test_message_ordering_preserved(self, services, kafka_consumer):
        orders = [create_order() for _ in range(10)]
        
        for order in orders:
            submit_order_async(order)
        
        # Messages arrive in order
        messages = kafka_consumer.consume(timeout=30, count=10)
        assert [m.order_id for m in messages] == [o["order_id"] for o in orders]
```
